shared_elements: long ankle-length robe with patterned/fringed hem
hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls
figure carrying/holding an object in outstretched hand
low relief figures facing one direction
footwear and feet shown in strict profile
justification: Both depict bearded men in strict profile with long fringed robes, curled hair rendered as stacked rows, and hands extended holding objects, which is a fairly specific shared figural convention. But A is a multi-register procession of many small repeated figures leading animals and bearing tribute, while B is a single monumental figure with large multi-tiered wings — no wings appear in A and no processional repetition in B.
